author: Sillygoose228
title: DLC "301 Moved Permanently" is delayed for another 3 months :(
content:
DLC "301 Moved Permanently" is delayed for another 3 months, said Spearhead Studios, the developer of Zero, in a new statement. The DLC will continue the story of the main protagonist after events of the main story and give the conclusion to his ark.


Another 3 months, could've been worse tbf.
